description:
**Job Title:** Talent Acquisition Specialist

**Location:** Yelahanka Campus, Bengaluru

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a driven and resourceful **Talent Acquisition Specialist** to lead end-to-end hiring initiatives for our Yelahanka campus. The ideal candidate will combine proactive sourcing strategies with structured interviewing and candidate relationship management to build strong talent pipelines and attract top-tier professionals across campus departments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Campus Sourcing & Pipeline Building:**
* Proactively source qualified candidates for Yelahanka campus roles through job portals (LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed), local talent networks, employee referrals, and social media.
* Build and maintain a ready talent pool for recurring and critical campus positions to reduce time-to-hire.
* **End-to-End Recruitment Management:**
* Partner with Yelahanka campus department heads and hiring managers to define role requirements, finalize job descriptions, and align on ideal candidate profiles.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial telephonic/video assessments, and coordinate on-site or virtual interview drives at the Yelahanka campus.
* Ensure clear, timely candidate communication throughout the hiring lifecycle to deliver a seamless candidate experience.
* **Offer Negotiation & Onboarding Handoff:**
* Conduct reference checks, prepare competitive compensation proposals aligned with organizational benchmarks, and manage offer negotiations.
* Drive offer acceptance and coordinate closely with the Yelahanka HR operations team for smooth pre-boarding and induction.
* **Employer Branding & Recruitment Analytics:**
* Collaborate on localized recruitment campaigns and LinkedIn job postings to strengthen the organization's employer brand in North Bengaluru.
* Track and report key recruitment metrics, including time-to-fill, source-of-hire, offer-to-join ratio, and hiring funnel conversion rates.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred).
* **Experience:** 2–4 years of full-cycle recruitment experience, preferably supporting campus, institutional, or multi-site operations in Bengaluru.
* **Technical Skills:** Hands-on experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search techniques, and job boards.
* **Core Competencies:** Strong negotiation and persuasion skills, sharp candidate assessment ability, stakeholder management, and familiarity with the North Bengaluru/Yelahanka talent market.

Benefits:

description:
* R024406

* Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

* IT Operations

* Regular

  

**Location Details:**Remote, India

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time, others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, Mississippi, North Dakota, or the Virgin Islands.

**Join Our Team...**

This role is for an AI Implementation Specialist in India within GoDaddy’s Finance Innovation team. You will design and deliver AI-powered solutions that modernize finance operations through agentic workflows, intelligent automation, analytics, enterprise integrations, and intuitive digital experiences. Working directly with finance and technology partners, you will turn complex business needs into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions!

This is an opportunity to apply hands-on engineering judgment across generative AI, Microsoft Power Platform, data, cloud services, APIs, and modern application development. You will own solutions from discovery and rapid prototyping through deployment, support, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with finance domain understanding, clear communication, and a practical focus on measurable outcomes, traceability, and control!

**What you'll get to do...**

#### **AI & Agent Engineering**

* Design and build AI agents, copilots, and intelligent assistants that streamline finance processes and improve decision-making.
* Develop agentic workflows using Microsoft Copilot Studio, large language models, OpenAI Agents SDK, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, structured outputs, multi-turn context, multi-agent orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop approvals.
* Ground AI outputs in trusted enterprise data, documented business rules, deterministic calculations, and actual tool results while handling uncertainty explicitly.

#### **Finance Automation & Solution Delivery**

* Partner with Finance stakeholders to understand processes, controls, reporting requirements, Pain points and expected business outcomes.
* Translate requirements into end-to-end designs spanning AI capabilities, workflow automation, data models, integrations, analytics, and user experiences.
* Automate data collection, reviews, approvals, reconciliations, reporting, document processing, and exception management using Power Automate, Office Scripts, APIs, and enterprise connectors.
* Integrate Microsoft Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive, Excel, Power BI, Jira, Slack, data platforms, and internal business systems.
* Own delivery from discovery, prototyping, development, and testing through deployment, production support, documentation, and iterative improvement.

#### **Application and Experience Development**

* Rapidly prototype and use vibe coding and AI-assisted software development to validate ideas, accelerate delivery, and turn business requirements into working solutions.
* Design responsive websites, internal portals, and user-focused interfaces and workflows using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web frameworks.
* Deliver full-stack capabilities through API integration, reusable components, and consistent Design patterns that improve maintainability and scale.

#### **Data, Analytics & Finance Technology**

* Write and optimize SQL for warehouse-style data, including joins, filters, aggregates, time ranges, hierarchies, and dimensional analysis.
* Building dashboards, scorecards, and analytical experiences using Power BI, Amazon QuickSight, Tableau, Excel, or modern web visualization frameworks.
* Support budget-versus-actual reporting, period comparisons, variance analysis, reconciliations, forecasting, operational KPIs, and management reporting.
* Align calculations and AI-generated commentary with accounting logic, finance definitions, reporting hierarchies, and clearly stated assumptions and exclusions.
* Build solutions that meet enterprise standards for accuracy, explainability, traceability, auditability, security, and governance

#### **Production Engineering, Security & Reliability**

* Build application services, APIs, background processes, and integrations using Python or other suitable technologies, with stable contracts and reusable patterns.
* Containerize and deploy solutions using Docker, environment-specific configuration, health checks, CI/CD, controlled releases, rollback, and scalable cloud architecture.
* Implement OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, identity-based access, role-based authorization, secure token handling, secrets management, logging, and monitoring.
* Diagnose failures across agents, flows, APIs, data pipelines, connectors, authentication, and third-party SDKs, and resolve the shared root cause.
* Contribute to technical standards, reusable playbooks, governance practices, and mentoring that improves delivery consistency across the team.

**Your experience should include...**

* 6+ years of experience in software engineering, information technology, data, automation, or related disciplines, including 2+ years delivering AI, machine learning, or generative AI solutions.
* Hands-on experience building production AI applications, MCP, agentic workflows, automation solutions, data products, or enterprise business applications.
* Practical expertise with the Microsoft Copilot studio and Power Automate, including tools, connectors, actions, approvals, and enterprise integrations.
* Experience with Large language models, prompt and context design, build and context inventing, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, AI evaluation, grounding, and responsible-AI guardrails.
* Understanding of AI governance, observability, evaluation, and responsible-AI practices in an enterprise setting.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, with the ability to move between application logic, APIs, analytical data, and business reporting definitions.
* Experience with cloud environments such as AWS, plus Docker, CI/CD, APIs, identity, access controls, secure configuration, and production observability.
* Experience creating dashboards, web experiences, prototypes, or internal tools with strong usability and visual design.
* Excellent analytical, documentation, stakeholder-management, and communication skills, capable of explaining technical choices, results, risks, assumptions, and limitations.
* Ability to work independently, make sound build-versus-reuse decisions, and deliver secure, maintainable solutions within a corporate setting.

**You might also have...**

* Experience delivering finance-focused copilots, intelligent document processing, reconciliations, variance analysis, forecasting, management reporting, or approval workflows.
* Knowledge of finance hierarchies, chart-of-accounts structures, cost centers, business units, fiscal calendars, controls, and auditability expectations.
* Experience with the OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP, Microsoft Graph, Office Scripts, reporting and analytics solutions such as Microsoft’s Power BI, Amazon’s QuickSight, Tableau, Jira, or Slack integrations.
* Experience building or maturing enterprise AI programs, including governance, observability, model or agent evaluation, data protection, and integration into business processes.
* Familiarity with identity management, access auditing, cloud security practices, and regulated or control-sensitive environments.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, Power Platform Solution Architect Expert, AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialist – Associate, or Google Cloud Professional AI Engineer.

*We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.*

**We've got your back...**We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.

title: Recruiting Coordinator Sr Analyst
description:
At NTT DATA, we know that with the right people on board, anything is possible. The quality, integrity, and commitment of our employees are key factors in our company’s growth, market presence, and our ability to help our clients stay a step ahead of the competition. By hiring the best people and helping them grow both professionally and personally, we ensure a bright future for NTT DATA and for the people who work here.
  
  
NTT DATA, Inc. currently seeks an Executive Hiring Coordinator to join our team in Gurugram.
  
  
Role summary
  
  
The Executive Hiring Coordinator runs the logistics of the hiring journey and is the single point of contact for candidates and hiring managers. You will coordinate scheduling, offers, background verification and onboarding so that every hand-off is on time and every candidate has smooth experience.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Open or update requisitions, validate demand and initiate the workflow.
* Single point of contact for executive candidate helping all coordination, administration from Open req to Day 1 onboarding.
* Schedule the intake calls between the recruiter and hiring manager, and capture and share the minutes.
* Schedule interviews, including rooms or virtual links, and coordinate executive travel.
* Follow up on interview feedback and update hiring managers on status.
* Prepare offers in the system, route them for approval and release them to the candidate for signature.
* Initiate background verification with the vendor and chase any pending documents.
* Facilitate the buddy program and fortnightly connects between the candidate, hiring manager and business HR.
* Coordinate pre-onboarding documents, IT assets, ID card and cabin, and set up a private Day 1 onboarding.
* Prepare the weekly SLA dashboard and flag risks and exceptions.
* Handle all candidate documents confidentially and in line with the quarterly compliance audit.

Skills and experience (suggested)
  
  

* [5–8] years in recruitment coordination, HR operations or executive assistance.
* Excellent organization, calendar management and follow-up discipline.
* Clear, courteous communication with senior stakeholders and candidates.
* Working knowledge of applicant tracking systems, e-signature tools and reporting in Excel.
* High standards of accuracy and confidentiality.

Working Hours
  

* This is an office-based position requiring attendance Monday through Friday.
* Working hours may be aligned to IST, CET, or EST/CST business hours based on operational requirements.
* The selected candidate must be flexible and willing to work night shifts, where required, to support global stakeholders and ensure continuity of service delivery.

We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Anthropic, Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.

We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**

Here at Version 1, we are currently recruiting for a ServiceNow Developer to join our thriving managed service practice. If you want to be involved in delivering value, innovation, and excellence with our customers, we would love to hear from you.

ASPIRE is Version 1 managed service framework that is currently transforming the way our customers consume services. The framework is continually evolving to ensure we are always delivering next generation services. Technology plays a key part in providing the underlying platform and capabilities. We are seeking a creative and experienced individual to join our team as a ServiceNow Developer.

**What You Will Do**

* Ensure the ServiceNow platform is up to date by applying patches and performing version upgrades.
* Automate application logic using workflow, scheduled script executions, and inbound and outbound email
* Create and manage workflows, including flow designer, to automate business processes.
* Design and maintain the Service Catalogue, including defining and configuring items, order guides, and workflows.
* Build and enhance UI components, including forms, lists, and UI pages.
* Write and maintain scripts (JavaScript, GlideScript) for various ServiceNow components such as business rules, client scripts, and UI policies.

* Develop and customise the ServiceNow Portal and ServiceNow applications in line with the needs of the business.
* Secure applications and data against access by unauthorised users and applications, employing best practices.

* Provide guidance to users on the usage of ServiceNow in line with its design

* Keep up-to-date with ServiceNow best practices and industry trends to ensure efficient and effective use of the platform
* Develop and maintain ServiceNow applications that support Domain Separation
* Develop reports and dashboards to provide data insights and monitoring capabilities

* Strong understanding of IT service management and the ITIL framework.

  + Implementation Specialist (Service Mapping)
  + Implementation Specialist (Discovery)

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance

* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

description:
Req ID: 60355

Job Function: Software Engineering

Posting Start Date: 26/11/2026

Posting End Date: 29/11/2026

Division: Digital

Job Location: IND-Bengaluru-RMZ Ecoworld

Advertised Salary: Competitive

**Recruiter: Mounika Nagabhiru**

**Hiring Manager: Dinesh Negi**

**Career Grade: E**

**Internal Closing Date: 15-July-2026**

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a GenAI Engineer to create, build, and scale production-grade Generative AI solutions that drive measurable business impact across enterprise operations. In this role, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, LLM-powered applications — including copilots, conversational agents, document intelligence platforms, and AI-driven automation deeply integrated with core enterprise systems.

  

You will work hands-on with leading managed and open-source LLM platforms — including Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, and open-source models — alongside enterprise-grade create frameworks such as Microsoft Copilot Studio. A critical dimension of this role is integrating GenAI capabilities into SAP S/4HANA and adjacent enterprise applications using APIs, events, OData services, and process orchestration.

  

This is a high-impact engineering role sitting at the intersection of AI innovation and enterprise technology. You will collaborate closely with product managers, SAP functional teams, backend engineers, and cloud platform architects to deliver AI capabilities that are not just technically sound but secure, compliant, cost-efficient, and ready for enterprise-scale adoption.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

** GenAI Platform Engineering:**   

* Create, develop, and deploy GenAI solutions using Azure OpenAI Service and AWS Bedrock, selecting appropriate foundation models (GPT-4o, Claude, Titan, Llama, Mistral) based on use-case requirements.
* Build, configure, and publish enterprise copilots using Microsoft Copilot Studio or equivalent low-code/pro-code frameworks, integrating with M365, Teams, SharePoint, and Dataverse.
* Architect and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines using vector databases (Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, Pinecone) and structured knowledge bases.
* Develop prompt engineering strategies — including few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought, and system instruction create — to optimize LLM output quality and consistency.

  

** Enterprise System Integration:**   

* Integrate GenAI capabilities with SAP S/4HANA using OData APIs, SAP Business Accelerator Hub connectors, event-driven architectures (SAP Event Mesh, BTP), and process triggers
* Build and maintain secure API layers (REST, GraphQL) tyingcting AI services to ERP, CRM, and operational data sources
* Collaborate with SAP functional and Basis teams to align AI touchpoints with existing business processes, authorization models, and data governance policies

** Architecture & Collaboration:**   

* Contribute to GenAI architecture decisions including platform selection, cost optimization strategies, multi-region deployment, and security design.
* Mentor associate engineers and participate in internal knowledge sharing through design reviews, documentation, and community of practice sessions.
* Engage with product managers and business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into technically feasible AI solution designs.

** Evaluation, Monitoring & Capable AI:**   

* Design and implement LLM evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, cost per token, and end-user satisfaction metrics.
* Establish monitoring pipelines for production AI applications using tools such as Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, and LangSmith.
* Apply capableble AI practices including content filtering, guardrails (Azure Content Safety, Bedrock Guardrails), bias detection, and explainability mechanisms.
* Manage model versioning, deprecation cycles, and prompt version control to ensure production stability

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on Generative AI, LLMs, or applied ML in production environments.
* Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI Service and AWS Bedrock — including model deployment, API integration, token management, and cost governance.
* Practical experience building copilots or AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Studio, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agentic frameworks.
* Strong understanding of RAG architecture, vector embeddings, chunking strategies, and retrieval optimization.
* Proficiency in Python (primary) and at least one secondary language (TypeScript, Java, or Node.js).
* Experience integrating AI services with enterprise systems — ideally SAP S/4HANA — using OData, REST APIs, or event-driven patterns.
* Solid understanding of enterprise security requirements including OAuth 2.0, managed identities, RBAC, secret management, and data residency compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms: Microsoft Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP for deploying and scaling AI workloads.
* Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines for AI application deployments.
* Experience with SAP Joule and SAP AI Core.
* Knowledge of SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) services, SAP Integration Suite, or SAP AI Core

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Our Package**
---------------

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.

BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.

Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.

We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

Recruiting

You will build and run a team that treats time-to-fill as a revenue measure, not an HR measure.

This is a player-coach role. You will lead the team and also stay hands-on in sourcing, screening, and closing, especially on the hardest and most urgent seats.

**What you will do**
====================

**Fill roles fast, with quality**
---------------------------------

* Own end-to-end recruiting, from requisition through offer acceptance and joining.
* Run daily demand reviews with delivery leaders and turn open client demand into a prioritized plan the team can act on that day.
* Keep a working view of open seats, aging, and expected revenue impact, and escalate any seat approaching a client commitment date.
* Build and maintain skill-based talent pipelines across core technical skill sets and experience levels, so candidates are ready before the demand arrives.
* Recruit hands-on for priority and hard-to-fill roles alongside the team.

**Lead and build the team**
---------------------------

* Lead, coach, and set targets for the talent acquisition team, and assign work by skill set and priority.
* Hire, onboard, and train recruiters, setting a clear standard for sourcing, screening, and candidate communication.
* Review team output every week and fix bottlenecks.

**Protect hiring integrity**
----------------------------

* Run a screening process built for a market where AI-written resumes, proxy interviews, and candidate substitution are real risks.
* Own the assessment approach for technical skills and business English, including proctoring and identity verification, and keep results consistent across recruiters.
* Work with HR on background checks, pre-joining verification, and managing drop-off between offer and joining.

**Run the systems and the data**
--------------------------------

* Run day-to-day use of our applicant tracking system and sourcing tools, driving data quality and adoption.
* Lead the team's adoption of the AI features in our applicant tracking system and other AI-based recruiting tools. Set clear standards for how the team uses them, show the results, and make AI-assisted work the normal way the team operates.
* Track recruiting metrics, including time-to-fill, quality of hire, and offer-to-joining ratio, and prepare weekly updates for leadership on the measures below, with recommended changes based on what the data shows.
* Evaluate and manage sourcing channels, job boards, and external search partners, with cost-per-hire in mind.
* Stay current on hiring trends, compensation benchmarks, and competitor activity, and use what you learn to refine recruiting strategy.

**Partner with the business**
-----------------------------

* Work with Operations leadership as the functional counterpart for demand. Operations sets which seats matter most, and you turn that into a daily recruiting plan.
* Give Operations an honest, early forecast of what is fillable, how fast, and at what cost, and flag seats at risk of missing a client commitment date.
* Act as the recruiting counterpart to delivery leaders and to HR and recruiting colleagues, and share tools, process, and learning across teams.
* Support growth planning, including large-volume programs that arrive on short timelines.

===========================

* Time-to-fill by role family, and revenue-days lost to open seats

* Rate of fraud and verification failures caught before offer

description:
Nutrition & Community Engagement Executive – Malayalam (Remote)

**Company:** SanoobFit  
**Location:** Remote – Kerala, India only  
**Job Type:** Part-Time / Full-Time  
**Experience:** Freshers & Experienced Professionals  
**Full-Time Salary:** ₹10,000–₹20,000/month + Commission  
**Work Mode:** 100% Work From Home

About SanoobFit

SanoobFit is a Dubai-based AI-powered fitness and nutrition platform helping people achieve their health goals through personalized training, nutrition tracking, and community support.

We are looking for **Malayalam-speaking nutrition and fitness enthusiasts** with excellent communication skills who enjoy connecting with people, providing guidance, and building client relationships.

This role combines **nutrition consultations, client engagement, community management, and program enrollment**.

Key Responsibilities

* Contact interested clients generated through our marketing campaigns.
* Conduct short introductory calls (2–4 minutes) to understand client needs.
* Provide detailed consultations (30–60 minutes) based on client requirements and professional qualifications.
* Understand clients' fitness and nutrition goals and provide appropriate guidance.
* Explain SanoobFit programs and assist clients with app onboarding.
* Manage daily calls, WhatsApp follow-ups, and client engagement.
* Support existing clients with consultations and progress reviews.
* Maintain accurate CRM records and meet performance targets.

Requirements

* **Fluent Malayalam communication is mandatory.**
* Qualification in Nutrition, Dietetics, Fitness, or a related field preferred.
* Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable with frequent calls, client follow-ups, and performance targets.
* Basic English communication skills.
* Laptop/desktop, smartphone, and reliable internet connection.
* Self-motivated and comfortable working independently.

Salary & Commission

**Full-Time Fixed Salary: ₹10,000–₹20,000/month**

Two salary categories are available depending on qualifications, responsibilities, and experience:

* **Category 1:** ₹10,000/month + Commission
* **Category 2:** ₹20,000/month + Commission

**Additional Commission: ₹50–₹1,000 per successful paid client enrollment (10% of package value).**

Example Monthly Earnings

Assuming an average commission of ₹500 per client:

**Category 1 — ₹10,000 Salary**

* 10 enrollments: ₹10,000 + ₹5,000 = **₹15,000/month**
* 20 enrollments: ₹10,000 + ₹10,000 = **₹20,000/month**

**Category 2 — ₹20,000 Salary**

* 10 enrollments: ₹20,000 + ₹5,000 = **₹25,000/month**
* 20 enrollments: ₹20,000 + ₹10,000 = **₹30,000/month**

*Commission is additional to fixed salary. Actual earnings depend on successful paid enrollments and package values. Examples are illustrative and not guaranteed.*

Working Hours

* **Part-Time:** 4 hours/day
* **Full-Time:** 8 hours/day
* Flexible shifts based on operational requirements.
* 100% remote working opportunity.

Selected candidates will initially undergo a **paid part-time performance evaluation**, with part-time compensation and terms communicated before joining.

Successful candidates may progress to full-time positions based on performance.

Career Growth

**Part-Time Associate → Full-Time Associate → Nutrition Consultant → Team Leader**

We provide opportunities for career development based on communication skills, client engagement, consultation quality, professional qualifications, and performance.

How to Apply

Apply through Indeed with your updated CV.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a brief screening assessment and telephone interview.

* Act as primary liaison between client and various studios with regard to naming conventions, campaigns storage, assets, new photography and archiving

* Learn about DAM

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

**About the role**

At Mott MacDonald, we use our expertise for the benefit of our clients and the communities they serve. We are looking for a GIS Consultant to join our growing teams, supporting major infrastructure, environmental, and land programmes through geospatial data management, spatial analysis, digital mapping solutions, and GIS platform administration.

This role offers the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that help shape sustainable and resilient communities while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across the UK and globally.

  

**What you will do**

As a GIS Consultant, you will:

* Create, maintain, manage and analyse spatial datasets using ArcGIS Pro and other GIS platforms.
* Publish and manage geospatial information through ArcGIS Portal and support Moata Geospatial data management activities.
* Produce high-quality mapping, visualisation and spatial analysis outputs to support infrastructure, environmental and land-related projects.
* Maintain data quality standards, metadata, coordinate systems and audit processes.
* Contribute to environmental constraints mapping, land referencing activities and project reporting.
* Investigate GIS-related issues and provide practical, user-focused solutions.
* Respond to GIS and Moata Geospatial support requests from project teams and shared service channels.
* Collaborate with colleagues across environmental, engineering, digital, land and GIS disciplines to deliver integrated project outcomes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance GIS processes, tools and ways of working.
  

**Candidate specification**

We welcome applications from individuals with a range of experiences and backgrounds. If you meet many, but not all, of the requirements below, we encourage you to apply.

Essential

* Degree or Master's qualification in GIS, Geography, Environmental Science, Geoinformatics, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrable experience applying GIS solutions within infrastructure, environmental, land, utilities or related sectors.
* Practical experience using ArcGIS Pro for data management, analysis and map production.
* Understanding of spatial data management principles, GIS workflows and quality assurance processes.
* Experience managing metadata, structured datasets and data governance requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Ability to prioritise workload, manage competing demands and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
* Attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.

**Primary Job Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Hiring Timeline (Hiring month):** Immediate

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

**About the Role**

We are looking for someone to run IT for our India office in Bengaluru. Day to day, that means setting up and looking after laptops, sorting out problems as they come up, managing Microsoft 365 and Intune for the India team, and dealing with local vendors. You will be our main IT person on the ground in India, working closely with the Corporate Technology team in North America, who look after security policy and the more complex Microsoft administration.

We do not have a proper service desk in India yet, and we would like you to set one up. That includes deciding how tickets are categorised, what hours are covered, who is on rotation, and how quickly we respond. If you have done something like this before, even for a small team, we would like to hear about it.

This is a hands-on job. As the team grows there will be room to lead people, but for now you will be doing most of the work yourself, and we are looking for someone who enjoys that.

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Laptops and other hardware for our India team, from ordering and setup through to repairs, returns, and keeping the asset register accurate
* Enrolling and managing devices in Intune, including compliance and app deployment
* Day-to-day Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration for India: user accounts, groups, licences, MFA, and access
* Onboarding and offboarding for India staff, so that new joiners are ready on their first day and leavers’ access and devices are handled properly
* Support tickets from the India team, and first-line support for colleagues in other regions during your working hours
* The technology in our Bengaluru office: network, Wi-Fi, firewall, printers, and meeting rooms
* Local vendors, warranty claims, and IT purchasing for India
* Setting up and running our service desk, and writing the runbooks the team will rely on
* Keeping devices secure and up to date (encryption, endpoint protection, patching) in line with our security policies, and raising anything suspicious straight away

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5 to 8 years in IT operations, where you have been the person responsible for IT at an office or business unit, or have looked after client companies at a managed service provider
* Solid hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, and a working understanding of Microsoft Defender
* Experience managing devices with an MDM. We use Intune, but experience with Jamf or a similar tool is fine
* Comfortable using PowerShell or Microsoft Graph alongside the admin portals. For example, you could pull a list of users or check licence usage with a script
* Good at diagnosing and fixing hardware problems, with a sound grasp of networking basics such as IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN
* You have set up or improved a service desk before, even a small one, and can talk us through what you did
* Clear spoken and written English. You will be working with colleagues in North America every day, as well as junior team members in India
* You like hands-on work. There is room to lead a team as we grow, but this role starts with you doing the work yourself

**Good to Have**

* Basic Linux skills, such as moving around the file system, managing files, and reading logs
* Experience with Fortinet or similar firewalls
* Experience with Freshservice or another service desk tool
* Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, MS-102, or AZ-104. Any certification on your resume should be current

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days**

* In your first 30 days: you have picked up India support tickets, got to know how our Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Intune environment is set up, and checked the India asset register against who actually has which device.
* By 60 days: you are handling onboarding and offboarding for India on your own, with the steps written down, and all India devices are enrolled and compliant in Intune.
* By 90 days: a first version of the India service desk is up and running, with agreed categories, coverage hours, and response times, and the most common fixes are documented.

**How We Will Measure Success**

* Ticket response and resolution times
* New joiners’ devices ready on day one, and leavers’ devices returned on time
* Accuracy of the asset register
* Device compliance in Intune
* Feedback from the people you support

**Interview Process**

* A screening call with our Talent Acquisition team, which includes a few short technical questions
* A technical conversation with a member of our Corporate Technology team
* A final round in person at our Bengaluru office with the Head of Corporate Technology. This includes a practical session in a Microsoft Entra and Azure test environment, and a conversation about hardware and device management

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

At Fulfillment IQ, we don’t just build supply chain solutions; we build long-term careers.  
We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you’re leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.

We operate with a high-trust, high-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.

Here’s what makes Fulfillment IQ a rewarding place to work:

**Work That Matters**  
You’ll help solve real operational challenges that directly impact global commerce, customer experience, and supply chain performance.

* Experience setting up HR processes in a small or growing company

* Organized and follows through without reminders
* Firm but approachable; can handle sensitive conversations calmly
* Trustworthy with confidential information

* Competitive salary of ₹25000 – ₹30000 per month
* Room to grow with the company
